region: USGS SIM 3464 and all Mars 2020 PLACES positions inside the downloaded crater-wide CTX DEM footprint

coordinateSystem.precisionNote: Stored decimal places are for stable coordinate encoding and do not imply that the source location is accurate to that precision.

sources.name: USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3464 geodatabase
sources.citation: Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M., 2020, Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars, USGS SIM 3464, scale 1:75,000.
sources.actualCoverage: MapBoundary layer in sim3464_map_coverage.geojson; the source map does not cover the full crater-wide CTX DEM. Unmapped area is unknown, not feature absence.

sources.name: Mars 2020 Rover PLACES, Release 16
sources.positionCaveat: best_interp is a localized/interpolated archive product. The PDS Release 16 notes report ROVER,n,0 rows were omitted; positions and motion between archived localizations must not be described as a fully observed wheel path.

sources.name: PDS Mars 2020 Three Forks Depot sample-drop events
sources.use: Sample names and event times only; not sufficient to position individual tubes. Do not infer coordinates from the image or from a nearby rover position.

notes: USGS SIM 3464 maps geology and landforms at 1:75,000; its geologic unit polygons are regional map interpretations, not astronaut-scale obstacle surveys.
USGS nomenclature points are centroids of text annotation polygons and serve only as display anchors.
The combined landmark point index has 10 items: two published reference points and USGS map-label anchors. Geologic extents and contacts are in companion vector layers.
USGS vectors are transformed from the supplied Mars Transverse Mercator projection to a Mars spherical geographic coordinate system, then clipped to the CTX DEM bounds.
Perseverance PLACES localizations are kept separate from geological features and from any generated astronaut routes.
